infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: dundundun reads data such as your step count, Activity rings, today’s sleep and nutrition, your weight over time, and workouts other apps recorded. It shows them beside your tasks and checks them against rules you set. It also reads your heart rate during a workout your Apple Watch measured in dundundun, to show on that workout’s page. Nothing is sent anywhere, and no copy is kept on this phone.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: dundundun saves an amount to Health, such as a glass of water or a coffee’s caffeine, when you complete a task you set up to log one. It saves a weight when you record one, a meal’s nutrition when you add the meal to the food log, and a strength workout when you choose to save a finished one. Nothing else is written. Deleting a food log entry or a workout removes what it saved.
infoPlist.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: dundundun rings reminders as system alarms that sound even in silent mode.
infoPlist.NSSiriUsageDescription: dundundun uses Siri to add a task, log a dose or a dream, mark a grocery item used up, or start a workout by voice, including from the Action Button.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: dundundun listens while you dictate a journal entry or a dream, so you can say it instead of typing it. The audio is turned into text on your phone and is never recorded or sent anywhere.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: dundundun turns what you say into text when you dictate a journal entry or a dream. It does this on your phone, without the internet.
infoPlist.NFCReaderUsageDescription: dundundun reads an NFC tag so you can use it as a key that locks and unlocks the apps you chose to block.

plugins.remindersPermission: dundundun moves tasks out of Reminders and into your Inbox, so anything you dictate to Siri ends up there.
plugins.calendarPermission: dundundun reads what’s already on a day in the calendars you pick, including a Google account added on this device, so it can tell how much of the day is free. It adds events only to a calendar you pick in Settings, for deadlines and planned meals you turn on. It changes nothing else.

plugins.contactsPermission: dundundun fills in one person you pick from your contacts, so you don’t have to type their name, number and birthday. It reads only the contacts you search for, one at a time, and never copies your address book.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: dundundun checks today’s weather where you are, so a rule you’ve set up (like sunscreen on a sunny day) can add its task. It also finds sunrise and sunset times for a task timed by the sun when you tap to save your location. If you turn on Suggest in mood log for a saved place, it also checks whether you’re there when you start a new mood entry. It never reads your location in the background.

plugins.faceIDPermission: dundundun asks for Face ID before it opens, so someone holding your unlocked phone can’t see your tasks.

plugins.photosPermission: dundundun reads a recipe from a photo you’ve already taken, so you don’t have to retype a cookbook page.
plugins.cameraPermission: dundundun reads what you point the camera at: a recipe from a cookbook page or clipping, a store receipt, or the barcode on a grocery item as you unpack it.
